text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm scared...!/Uuu, I'm scared...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine! Since you came all the 
way out to tour the academy, why not take 
a proper look around?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing crying sounds, I went over to 
check, and found Ines Fujin and Biwa 
Hayahide soothing a child.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I was just showing the track 
to a kid who came for an academy tour, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the students jostle during training 
frightened them. It felt pitiful to just 
send them home, though...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It'd be such a waste to leave it 
like this! If we just explain it 
properly...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...So you see, it's a very meaningful 
relationship where they elevate each 
other. They're definitely not fighting.

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: I-I was mad... We had a fight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"If pushing doesn't work, try pulling! 
Just try talking to them real~ly gently~."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not scary at all, okay~? Racing is 
super fun~âª Tra-la-laâª

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Somehow that makes it even scarier!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I tried every trick in the book to 
get its attention, but...! It won't come 
anywhere near the track!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm, this reminds me of my little sister 
stubbornly refusing to eat her vegetables. 
Though when it came to running, she would 
eagerly chase after me, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's the same at my house. Whenever 
I try to head out for training, my little 
sisters cling right onto me—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how about big sis and the others 
go play on the track~! Looks like we're 
allowed to use that course over there!

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're right, running on an open, spacious 
track feels amazing, but... oh well! We 
big sisters will just go have fun by 
ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: W-Wait...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! The staff grooms the turf 
every single day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's a gentle slope around here, so I 
often run it when I want to train my 
stamina. And then—

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Wait up! You big sisters are too fast...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, don't worry! I know you can 
definitely catch up!

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah... G-Geez!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's where Trainer is always watching 
over me! I hear you can see the whole 
course really well from there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone realized it, it had 
basically turned into a race. Ines Fujin 
was going easy, but the child seemed to be 
running all out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes the academy tour! 
Please get home safely!

text_block_list.name: Shy-Looking Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Hey, big sisters. Playing tag was 
so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's race again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bye-byee! ...Fufu.
choice_data_list:
Did your future underclassman show 
promise?
As expected of an older sister!
As expected of an older sister!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Bye-byee! ...Fufu.
choice_data_list:
Did your future underclassman show 
promise?
As expected of an older sister!
As expected of an older sister!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Super much!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was watching from afar, and you 
did well keeping up with Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she followed me with such sparkling 
eyes... If that kid grows up and comes to 
Tracen Academy—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—No, I just hope they can make it all the 
way to the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm sure... we'll be able to have fun 
competing together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The caring Ines Fujin. Yet at the same 
time, her eyes burned with a fierce 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, it's not that big a deal♪ I just 
really wanted to show you how much fun it 
is to run with someone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Hayahide-chan, the track is 
still open, so let's get a quick run in!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, as long as it is after I report to the 
student council that the tour is finished, 
I do not mind—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yay! In that case, race you to the student 
council room!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...See! Wouldn't it be such a waste to go 
on without knowing about something this 
wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A devoted elder sister, yet at the same 
time someone who finds extraordinary joy 
in running... I caught a glimpse of that 
side of Ines Fujin!
